Purpose: REALTIME NOTIFICATIONS
Verify production stage popup appears for customer when stage is updated
Precondition Details: Customer has an active RFQ
Steps:
1. Staff logs in to Dashboard.
2. Go to Production tab.
3. Move RFQ card to next stage by clicking the forward button.
4. Observe Customer Dashboard.
Test Data: Active RFQ with a production stage
Expected Results: Customer receives toast popup within 2 seconds showing the new stage name without page refresh.

Purpose: Verify clicking production stage popup navigates to Production tab
Precondition Details: Customer Dashboard is open on any tab
Steps:
1. Wait for production stage popup to appear.
2. Click on the popup.
Expected Results: Popup dismisses and CustomerDashboard switches to the Production Progress tab.

Purpose: Verify all online staff receive popup when customer sends a message
Precondition Details: At least one staff member is online on Dashboard
Steps:
1. Customer logs in.
2. Open Messages tab.
3. Select an RFQ conversation.
4. Type and send a message.
Test Data: Message: I have a question about dimensions
Expected Results: All logged-in staff members receive a toast popup with sender name and 80-char message preview within 2 seconds.

Purpose: Verify clicking message popup opens correct chat conversation
Precondition Details: Staff Dashboard is open on Overview tab
Steps:
1. Customer sends a message for RFQ-2025-003.
2. Wait for popup on Staff Dashboard.
3. Click the popup.
Expected Results: Messages tab opens and the conversation for RFQ-2025-003 is automatically selected.

Purpose: Verify customer receives popup when staff sends a message
Precondition Details: Customer Dashboard is open
Steps:
1. Staff sends a message in an RFQ conversation.
2. Observe Customer Dashboard.
Expected Results: Customer receives toast popup showing staff name and message preview.

Purpose: Verify all staff receive popup when customer creates new RFQ
Precondition Details: Staff Dashboard is open
Steps:
1. Customer logs in.
2. Click Create New Request.
3. Fill in form and submit.
Test Data: Customer name: Test Company; Product: PE Tank
Expected Results: All online staff receive a popup showing the new customer name and RFQ code.

Purpose: Verify clicking new RFQ popup navigates to Requests tab
Precondition Details: Staff Dashboard is open on Dashboard Overview
Steps:
1. Wait for new RFQ popup to appear.
2. Click the popup.
Expected Results: Popup dismisses, activeMenu switches to Requests tab, and the RFQ list refreshes.

Purpose: Verify message sender does NOT receive popup from own message
Precondition Details: Customer Dashboard is open
Steps:
1. Customer opens Messages tab.
2. Sends a message.
3. Observe for any popup on Customer Dashboard.
Expected Results: No popup appears on the Customer's own screen after sending the message.

Purpose: Verify Done stage triggers special completion popup message
Precondition Details: Customer has an RFQ in Delivering stage
Steps:
1. Staff moves RFQ from Delivering to Done.
2. Observe Customer Dashboard.
Expected Results: Customer popup shows the RFQ code completed message with text stating the order has completed the full production process.

Purpose: Verify notification is saved to DB and visible in bell list
Precondition Details: Customer Dashboard is open
Steps:
1. Staff triggers a stage change for customer's RFQ.
2. Customer clicks the bell icon.
3. Review notification list.
Expected Results: The production stage notification appears in the dropdown notification list with correct title and message.

Purpose: GLOBAL SEARCH
Verify Ctrl+K opens the global search modal
Precondition Details: Staff Dashboard is open on any tab
Steps:
1. Press Ctrl+K on keyboard.
2. Observe screen.
Expected Results: Global search modal appears with input focused, placeholder text visible, and no results shown.

Purpose: Verify search by RFQ code returns matching results
Precondition Details: Global search modal is open
Steps:
1. Press Ctrl+K.
2. Type RFQ-2025 in search input.
Expected Results: Results appear grouped under Quotation Requests showing all RFQs whose code contains RFQ-2025 with correct status badges.

Purpose: Verify search by customer name returns results across multiple groups
Precondition Details: Global search modal is open
Steps:
1. Press Ctrl+K.
2. Type a customer name that exists in both RFQs and Customer list.
Expected Results: Results appear in both the Quotation Requests group and the Customers group.

Purpose: Verify keyboard navigation with arrow keys and Enter
Precondition Details: Search modal open with results visible
Steps:
1. Type a search query.
2. Press the down arrow key twice.
3. Press Enter.
Expected Results: Active highlight moves to 3rd result on double down-arrow; pressing Enter closes modal and navigates to that result.

Purpose: Verify clicking RFQ result navigates to correct tab and opens detail
Precondition Details: Search modal open with RFQ results
Steps:
1. Type an RFQ code.
2. Click on an RFQ result.
Expected Results: Modal closes, Dashboard switches to Quotation Requests tab, and RFQ detail modal opens for the selected RFQ.

Purpose: Verify clicking Customer result pre-fills customer search field
Precondition Details: Search modal open with Customer results
Steps:
1. Type customer name or email.
2. Click on a Customer result.
Expected Results: Modal closes, Dashboard switches to Customers tab, and the search box is pre-filled with the customer identifier.

Purpose: Verify empty query shows placeholder state
Precondition Details: Global search modal is open
Steps:
1. Press Ctrl+K to open modal.
2. Do not type anything.
Expected Results: Modal shows placeholder icon and instructional text with no result items displayed.

Purpose: Verify Esc key closes the search modal
Precondition Details: Global search modal is open
Steps:
1. Press Ctrl+K.
2. Optionally type something.
3. Press Esc key.
Expected Results: Modal closes immediately; user remains on the same tab they were on before opening search.

Purpose: REVENUE REPORT
Verify Revenue Report page loads correctly
Precondition Details: Manager is on Staff Dashboard
Steps: 1. Click Bao cao (Reports) menu item in sidebar.
Expected Results: Revenue Report page loads with 4 KPI cards, 2 charts, and 2 ranking tables visible. Time filter buttons visible at top.

Purpose: Verify Total Revenue KPI only counts approved quotations
Precondition Details: At least 1 approved and 1 sent quotation exist
Steps:
1. Open Revenue Report page.
2. Note Total Revenue KPI value.
3. Verify against sum of approved quotations only.
Expected Results: Total Revenue matches the sum of totalAmount for all quotations with status approved only. Sent and draft quotations are excluded.

Purpose: Verify time filter updates all charts and KPIs simultaneously
Precondition Details: Revenue Report page is open
Steps:
1. Note current values with Year filter.
2. Click 3 months filter button.
3. Observe all components.
Expected Results: All 4 KPI cards, both charts, and both ranking tables update simultaneously to reflect only the last 3 months of data.

Purpose: Verify growth badge shows correct percentage change vs previous month
Precondition Details: Revenue exists in both current and previous month
Steps:
1. Open Revenue Report.
2. Observe the growth badge under Total Revenue KPI.
Test Data: Current month revenue greater than previous month
Expected Results: Growth badge shows green color with correct positive percentage. If current is less than previous, shows red with negative percentage.

Purpose: Verify AreaChart tooltip shows correct revenue values on hover
Precondition Details: Revenue Report page open with data
Steps: 1. Hover mouse over a data point on the monthly revenue AreaChart.
Expected Results: Tooltip appears showing the Da chot and Pipeline values for that month in Vietnamese currency format.

Purpose: Verify Top Customers table is ranked by revenue descending
Precondition Details: At least 3 customers with approved quotations exist
Steps:
1. Open Revenue Report.
2. Review Top Customers table order.
Expected Results: Customers listed in descending order by total approved revenue. Customer number 1 progress bar equals 100%; others are proportional.

Purpose: Verify empty state shows placeholder when no data in selected time range
Precondition Details: No approved quotations in the last 3 months
Steps:
1. Open Revenue Report.
2. Click 3 months filter.
Expected Results: Charts show placeholder text indicating no data is available for this period instead of broken charts. No JavaScript errors.

Purpose: Verify Reports tab is not visible for Engineer role
Precondition Details: Engineer account is logged in
Steps:
1. Log in as Engineer role.
2. Check the sidebar menu items.
Expected Results: The Bao cao (Reports) menu item does NOT appear in the sidebar for the Engineer role.

Purpose: RFQ TABLE ENHANCEMENTS (DEADLINE, SORT, EXPORT)
Verify Deadline column displays for RFQ with expectedDate set
Precondition Details: At least one RFQ with expectedDate exists
Steps:
1. Go to Quotation Requests tab.
2. Find an RFQ with expectedDate set.
3. Observe the Deadline column.
Expected Results: Deadline column shows a badge with the date in DD/MM/YYYY format with gray color and calendar icon.

Purpose: Verify Deadline badge shows red for overdue RFQs
Precondition Details: RFQ exists with expectedDate in the past
Steps:
1. Go to Quotation Requests tab.
2. Find RFQ with past expectedDate.
3. Check Deadline badge.
Expected Results: Deadline badge shows red background with text indicating the number of overdue days (e.g. Tre 1d).

Purpose: Verify Deadline badge shows amber for RFQs due within 3 days
Precondition Details: RFQ exists with expectedDate within next 1 to 3 days
Steps:
1. Go to Quotation Requests tab.
2. Find RFQ due in 2 days.
3. Check Deadline badge.
Expected Results: Deadline badge shows amber/yellow background with text indicating remaining days (e.g. Con 2d).

Purpose: Verify Deadline column shows dash for RFQ without expectedDate
Precondition Details: RFQ exists with no expectedDate
Steps:
1. Go to Quotation Requests tab.
2. Find an RFQ with no deadline set.
3. Observe Deadline column.
Expected Results: Deadline column shows a dash in light gray for that row.

Purpose: Verify clicking column header sorts table ascending
Precondition Details: Quotation Requests tab open with multiple RFQs
Steps:
1. Click Customer column header.
2. Observe sort order.
Expected Results: Table rows re-sort alphabetically A to Z by customer name. An up arrow icon appears next to the Customer header.

Purpose: Verify clicking same sorted column header reverses to descending
Precondition Details: Table already sorted ascending by a column
Steps:
1. Click the same column header again.
2. Observe sort direction.
Expected Results: Table re-sorts in reverse order Z to A. Icon changes from up arrow to down arrow.

Purpose: Verify sort resets pagination to page 1
Precondition Details: User is on page 2 or later in RFQ table
Steps:
1. Navigate to page 2 of the RFQ list.
2. Click any sortable column header.
Expected Results: Pagination resets to Page 1 after sort is applied.

Purpose: Verify Export Excel button downloads a CSV file
Precondition Details: Quotation Requests tab is open
Steps:
1. Click the Xuat Excel button.
2. Observe browser download.
Expected Results: Browser downloads a file named RFQ_[today's date].csv (e.g. RFQ_05-05-2026.csv).

Purpose: Verify exported CSV contains correct columns and data
Precondition Details: CSV file has been downloaded
Steps:
1. Open downloaded CSV in Excel or text editor.
2. Check column headers and data.
Expected Results: CSV contains exactly 9 columns: Ma RFQ, Khach hang, SDT, Email, San pham, Tong SL, Trang thai, Ngay tao, Deadline. Data matches filtered table.

Purpose: Verify CSV displays Vietnamese characters correctly in Excel
Precondition Details: CSV file has been downloaded
Steps:
1. Open downloaded CSV with Microsoft Excel.
2. Check Vietnamese text display.
Expected Results: Vietnamese characters display correctly without garbled characters or question mark symbols.

Purpose: UPLOAD AVATAR
Verify avatar upload area is visible in Profile Settings
Precondition Details: User is logged in
Steps:
1. Click on user avatar or name in header.
2. Select Ho so ca nhan.
3. Observe Profile tab.
Expected Results: Circular avatar area (96x96px) is visible at the top of the profile form showing current image or initials placeholder.

Purpose: Verify clicking avatar area opens file picker
Precondition Details: User is on Profile Settings page
Steps:
1. Hover over the avatar circle.
2. Observe hover state.
3. Click on the avatar circle.
Expected Results: Hover shows camera icon overlay with Change text. Clicking opens OS file picker dialog for image files only.

Purpose: Verify valid image file uploads successfully
Precondition Details: File picker is open
Steps:
1. Click avatar circle.
2. Select a valid JPG file under 5MB.
3. Confirm the upload.
Expected Results: Upload succeeds. Success toast appears. New image displays in avatar circle immediately.

Purpose: Verify avatar updates on header and sidebar without page reload
Precondition Details: User successfully uploaded a new avatar
Steps:
1. Upload a new avatar image.
2. Observe the header top-right avatar and sidebar bottom user info.
Expected Results: Both header and sidebar avatars update to the new image immediately without requiring a page reload.

Purpose: Verify file larger than 5MB shows error message
Precondition Details: User is on Profile Settings page
Steps:
1. Click avatar circle.
2. Select an image file larger than 5MB.
Expected Results: Error message appears stating file size must not exceed 5MB. No upload is performed.

Purpose: Verify non-image file type shows error message
Precondition Details: User is on Profile Settings page
Steps:
1. Click avatar circle.
2. Attempt to select a PDF or TXT file.
Expected Results: Error message appears stating only JPG PNG WEBP images are supported. Upload is blocked.

Purpose: Verify Delete Avatar resets to default initials placeholder
Precondition Details: User currently has an uploaded avatar image
Steps:
1. Go to Profile Settings.
2. Click Xoa anh (Delete Avatar) button.
Expected Results: Avatar reverts to default colored circle with user name initials. avatarUrl is cleared from the user record.

Purpose: Verify uploaded avatar persists after logout and re-login
Precondition Details: User has successfully uploaded an avatar
Steps:
1. Upload avatar.
2. Log out.
3. Log back in with same credentials.
4. Observe avatar.
Expected Results: The uploaded avatar image still displays correctly after re-login, confirming it was saved to the database.

Purpose: AI CHATBOT
Verify AI Chatbot widget is visible on homepage
Precondition Details: User accesses homepage without login
Steps:
1. Open browser.
2. Navigate to homepage URL.
3. Look for chat widget at bottom-right.
Expected Results: A circular chat button with blue background is visible fixed at the bottom-right corner of the homepage.

Purpose: Verify chat widget opens with welcome message and quick option chips
Precondition Details: Homepage is loaded
Steps: 1. Click the chat button at bottom-right.
Expected Results: Chat window opens with a greeting message and 3 clickable option chips: Tim hieu san pham, Yeu cau bao gia, Lien he tu van.

Purpose: Verify clicking a quick option chip sends message and receives AI response
Precondition Details: Chat widget is open with quick options visible
Steps:
1. Open chat widget.
2. Click Tim hieu san pham chip.
3. Wait for response.
Test Data: Quick option: Tim hieu san pham
Expected Results: Chip text is sent as a user message. Typing indicator appears. AI responds within 10 seconds with relevant OPEP product information.

Purpose: Verify typing a custom question receives a relevant AI response
Precondition Details: Chat widget is open
Steps:
1. Open chat widget.
2. Type: What plastic tanks do you offer?
3. Press Enter or click Send.
Test Data: Message: What plastic tanks do you offer?
Expected Results: User message appears as a blue bubble. AI responds with information about OPEP's tank products including PE, PP, PVC, FRP types.

Purpose: Verify typing indicator shows while waiting for AI response
Precondition Details: Chat widget is open
Steps:
1. Send any message.
2. Immediately observe chat window.
Expected Results: Input field is disabled, send button shows loading spinner, and animated typing indicator with 3 dots appears in chat.

Purpose: Verify message over 500 characters disables the send button
Precondition Details: Chat widget is open
Steps:
1. Open chat widget.
2. Paste or type a message longer than 500 characters.
Expected Results: Character counter turns red showing over-limit count. Send button becomes disabled. Message cannot be submitted.

Purpose: Verify chat history persists when widget is closed and reopened
Precondition Details: User has sent at least 2 messages in chat
Steps:
1. Exchange 2 or more messages with chatbot.
2. Click X to close widget.
3. Click chat button to reopen.
Expected Results: All previous messages from both user and bot are still visible in the chat window after reopening.

Purpose: Verify fallback message displays when AI API returns an error
Precondition Details: Chat widget open; API endpoint unavailable
Steps:
1. Simulate API failure by stopping backend.
2. Send a message in chat.
Expected Results: Bot responds with fallback message including the hotline number 0913 213 091. Chat does not crash or show a blank screen.
